data.name: Girl Scouts Badges
data.headline: Earn a badge with our animal ambassadors
data.description:
Our Girl Scout activities include 90-minute tours that meet ALL badge requirements. You can choose to add the badge to your order so that each girl scout will go home with the appropriate badge for their vest or sash. You can even purchase a custom Helen Woodward Animal Center patch to commemorate the visit! 

* A minimum of 5 children is required to make this booking, however you may bring less children on the day of the program. You will not be refunded the difference if less than 5 children attend.
data.itinerary:
* The program will begin with a brief introduction and set up rules and expectations.
* Rotate animals and locations about every 15 minutes depending on species. Typically we introduce the individual animal then talk about its species based on the focus of the selected theme, allowing for interaction and questions near the end of the presentation.
* Rotate activities and locations about 30 minutes depending on activity type.

meeting_point.address: 6447 Helen Woodward Way Rancho Santa Fe, CA US 92067

data.what_is_included:
Our Girl Scout activities include 90-minute tours that meet ALL badge requirements and girl scouts will go home with the appropriate badge for their vest or sash.
* For Daisies, Brownies, Juniors, and Cadettes

Opportunity to earn the following badges:
* Eco Learner Badge
* Pets Badge
* Animal Habitats Badge
* Animal Helpers Badge!
* _Coming soon is more in the Eco badge series!_
data.what_is_not_included: Food and drinks aren't provided or readily available onsite. We have water bottle refill stations.
what_is_not_included_items: Food and drinks aren't provided or readily available onsite. We have water bottle refill stations.
data.cancellation_notes:
- We operate rain or shine.
- Canceling 31+ days prior: Will result in a refund of 75% of the paid value.
- Canceling within 30 days of your scheduled event: Will result in no refund.
- Rescheduling 31+ days prior: Will result in a fee of 30% of the paid value.
- We will allow your program to be rescheduled without a penalty for up to 3 business days once it has been booked. We are not able to reschedule within 30 days of your scheduled event and you will not receive a refund.
data.booking_notes:
#We are looking forward to seeing you!
#Check in Procedure
Meet at Education in the large covered pavilion. Plan to arrive 10 minutes before your program start time. Late arrival results in a shorter program with less time for animal interaction. Your instructor(s) will be waiting for you at the Education Department.
data.check_in_details: Our Instructor will be expecting your arrival, but may not immediately be out there to greet you if they are finishing room and animal preparation, especially if you arrive early. In that scenario you can come into the covered pavilion and can sit at our picnic tables and play in the pavilion space while waiting. Once the program is closer to start time, the Instructor will ask for your name to cross reference with a check list and then will shortly begin the program.
data.special_requirements: * Must be at least 5-years old to pet reptiles.
data.restrictions: * We can only run 1 badge type at a time. A different badge requires a separate booking. If more than 1 badge type is selected we will default to the lowest level of badge selected.
data.health_and_safety_notes: To ensure the health and safety of our program participants, staff, and animals, please read our Health and Safety Policy by clicking the link below.
data.disclaimers: * Species may vary depending on animal health, safety and availability.
